free_resources.title: Meditation for Stress & Anxiety
free_resources.description: A free MIDL practice page on retraining habitual chest breathing into slow belly breathing over a few weeks, with written steps, a video and a guided audio. It frames stress and anxiety as an alarm to understand rather than fight.

free_resources.title: Meditation Skill 00: Diaphragmatic Breathing
free_resources.description: The opening skill of the MIDL system: twenty minutes a day lying on the floor, learning to breathe from the belly so the body can settle before mindfulness of breathing. Includes video instructions and a guided recording.

free_resources.title: MIDL Meditation for Anxiety (PDF)
free_resources.description: A free PDF book from Stephen's library on using the experience of stress and anxiety as a path into mindfulness meditation, gathering the breathing and relaxation skills taught on the MIDL site.
